newsitem.title: USA: Regions says to acquire First Bankshares.
newsitem.headline: Regions says to acquire First Bankshares.

text.p: Regions Financial Corp said Monday it had agreed in principle to acquire First Bankshares Inc in a stock swap.
It said 0.32 Regions share would be exchanged for each First Bankshares share. The exchange ration is subject to adjustment, Regions said.
Based on Regions's closing stock price of $51.625 on December 13, the transaction would be valued at about $18.9 million.
The merger, which will be accounted for as a pooling of interests, is expected to be completed during the second quarter of 1997, pending approval by First Bankshares shareholders.
The deal is also subject to regulatory approval and other customary conditions of closing. The transaction is expected to be a tax-free reorganization for federal income tax purposes, Regions said.

First Bankshares's First Bank of Georgia has a total of three banking offices, in East Point, Fairburn and Hapeville, Ga. At September 30, it had total assets of $106 million, deposits of $83 million, and stockholder equity of $8.7 million.
First Bank of Georgia reported net income of $1.3 million for the first nine months of 1996.
